message: Hi, my kid Ivy is 9 and wants to try martial arts. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Little Hammer Kids Martial Arts for ages 5-12, which covers Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Wrestling, MMA, and Kickboxing throughout the week. It's a great fit for Ivy. Is she interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, she would love to try a free trial class! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the confirmation to?
You can send the confirmation to tester.falcon@gmail.com.
Perfect! And is this the best number to reach you at, or would you like to give me a different one?
Great, got it! Now I just need Ivy's full name and date of birth to get her trial class scheduled.
Ivy Falcon, and her birthday is October 12, 2017.

Perfect!
I have a few spots available this week for Ivy's free trial:

Tuesday 7/7 at 5:15 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 5:30 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:15 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/7 at 5:15 PM. Thank you!

All set! Ivy is booked for her free trial on Tuesday, July 7th at 5:15 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.falcon@gmail.com. We're excited to meet her! Let me know if you have any questions before then.
